Headquartered in the capital region of Muscat, Starcare Oman is a network of hospitals, medical centres and pharmacies. More than 500 people work here, including experienced doctors, nurses and paramedics.
Accreditation by JCI, PSFHI and ISO made Starcare the first triple-accredited hospital in the Sultanate. Eighty per cent of our patients are Omani nationals.

Starcare Hospital Seeb is a multi-speciality premium hospital designed to the standards of the American Architectural Institute. It offers 24-hour emergency care, outpatient, day-care and inpatient services, modular operating theatres, diagnostic facilities, labour and delivery suites and star-rated inpatient rooms.

The hospitals are managed by Starcare Health Systems Limited, a healthcare management and consultancy company incorporated in the UK and based in Manchester, with operations in Oman, the UAE and India.

“Back and neck pain can result from a variety of causes, when nerves are stressed by adjacent bones and other tissues. This can happen from regular movements, such as simply bending over or from strenuous activity, trauma, ageing or infection. We specialize in minimally invasive spine surgeries and endoscopic spine surgeries, along with other treatments for common spinal problems like slipped or herniated disc, spondylosis, spinal trauma and fractures, spondylolisthesis and spine tumors etc. It is a multidisciplinary teamwork, making it easier for patients to receive care for a variety of spine and nerve problems, including surgical and non-surgical treatment, rehabilitation and pain management

A multidisciplinary clinic for back, neck and spine disorders, headed by Dr. Ahmed Jahwari.

Starcare Hospital, Barka has officially opened a Spine Clinic that bring together the region’s top Ortho/Spine surgeons to provide multidisciplinary, patient-focused care for a variety of back, neck and spine disorders. The Clinic is headed by Dr. Ahmed Jahwari, MD, FRCS CANADA, Sr. Consultant- Orthopaedic & Trauma Care. The Orthopaedic & Spine Clinic at Starcare Barka has full-fledged team of experienced surgeons, Dr.Paul P Antony, MBBS, MS (Orthopedics) SICOT Fellow Shoulder & Elbow Surgery (Germany) AO Fellow (Germany).

Dr.Raphael Charrabeh, MD Orthopedic & Trauma Specialty (Syrian Board) and Dr.Ahmed Said Ali Al-Mandhari, BSc, MD, MRCS , MCCE, ( Fellow in shoulder and Elbow surgery - UK ). Expert Physiotherapists are also part of the Spine care Team. Dr. Ahmed Jahwari completed his graduation from Sultan Qaboos University, Oman and MD from College of Medicine SQU. He is a certified Orthopedic Surgeon from the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada.

He is honored and awarded with Best Trainer of the Year OMSB, Bernard Ghert Award for resident excellence in patient focused care, University of Toronto, Zimmer Research Grant Awarded 1st prize and has received an honor degree from Sultan Qaboos University. “Back and Neck pain are most common health issues for a large number of people. However, there are many misconceptions and fear among people regarding the results of treatment of spinal problems.

Many people put up with the suffering rather than getting correct treatment simply because of lack of awareness about what all modern Spine care treatment methods can offer” said Dr. Sadik Kodakat, Consultant Anesthesiologist & Chairman of Starcare Group in the press meet conducted at the Hospital in Barka. Mr. Nasser Batha Group CEO of Starcare Oman added that, with the addition of Spine Clinic in the orthopedic division of Starcare Barka, we intend to provide accurate diagnosis, choose best treatment, and execute the treatment in best possible manner for every single patient.

Surgery option chosen only when non-surgical treatment fails to provide adequate relief to the patient. When needed, surgeries will be carried out with the latest technologies at our well-equipped operation theaters. We specialize in minimally invasive spine surgeries and endoscopic spine surgeries, along with other treatments for common spinal problems like slipped or herniated disc, spondylosis, spinal trauma and fractures, spondylolisthesis and spine tumors etc.

It is a multidisciplinary teamwork, making it easier for patients to receive care for a variety of spine and nerve problems, including surgical and non-surgical treatment, rehabilitation and pain management said Dr. Ahmed Jahwari “Back and neck pain can result from a variety of causes, when nerves are stressed by adjacent bones and other tissues. This can happen from regular movements, such as simply bending over or from strenuous activity, trauma, ageing or infection.

Having a multi-disciplinary team to be able to correctly diagnose wide ranges of spine problems allow us to provide the best patient care possible.,” “We are all working together for the patient’s best interests in mind.” He added. Starcare Barka has strived to provide the services of experienced and well known doctors and Senior Visiting Consultants from different specialties including Orthopedic Surgeries, weight reduction surgery, Gynecologic Laparoscopic Surgery, Pediatric Surgery and ENT surgeries.

Now it has become the preferred centre for complex orthopedic surgeries like joint replacement, shoulder arthroscopy and Spine surgeries. We were in the news last year for doing the first Shoulder Joint Replacement surgery in the private sector in Oman. We are now looking forward to be the Centre of Excellence in Spine care” Said Mr. Vinod, Chief Operating officer of Starcare Hospital Barka.

Starcare hospital has been selected by the prestigious World HRD Congress as the Best Employer for Oman in Healthcare, 2019 after carefully considering multiple parameters including diversified culture, equal opportunity for women leaders, employee benefits and engagements, empowering and developing Omani nationals. “People are the backbone of our organisation and the most valuable assets. The 28th edition of the World HRD Congress aims to recognise the efforts of the healthcare organisations that have strived to attract and retain talent. Featuring the best organisations in Oman, Starcare Group was selected by World HRD Congress as the Preferred Employer in healthcare by the international jury. “At Starcare we aim to promote the professional and personal growth of the employees, it is important to maintain a healthy work-life balance to attain productivity”, commented Dr Sadik Kodakat, chairman of Starcare Group, expressing his happiness on being selected as the best employer.

Starcare names Nasser Batha as group CEO
The founding partner takes charge of the hospitals at Seeb and Barka and the medical centres at Bowsher, Mabela and Duqm.

The Starcare Group which started its journey in 2010 in Oman has made remarkable progress in establishing itself as the benchmark for accreditation quality healthcare in the country. The group has expanded its footprints beyond Oman to India and UAE in the past years apart from the ambitious super speciality projects in progress. Clearly, on the verge of a new horizon, the group is in need of strong and multifaceted leader with astute business acumen.

The Chairman and Board of Directors unanimously nominated Mr Nasser Batha, Founding Partner of the Group to assume responsibility as the CEO of Starcare Group in Oman. A sought after management professional and a passionate entrepreneur, Nasser Batha has been heading business units of international brands like EMAAR, AMADEUS, Emirates, KLM and others across the globe in an extensive career spanning 3 decades. Hailed for expansions, start-ups and turnaround ventures, he demonstrates pro-active leadership and ability to deliver financial and business growth.

An MBA from Bradford, UK, Nasser keeps abreast with the developments in the field and remains a strong advocate of technology and innovation. Welcoming the new CEO, Dr Sadik Kodakat, Chairman, Starcare Group remarked “Nasser has always been part of the key decisions and strategies made by Starcare. But now, we will have his dedicated attention to the business as we pursue our ambitious growth plans in Oman”. An analytical thinker and quick decision maker, Nasser benefits from his vast experience in the Middle East and Europe part from his ability to handle seven languages.

He would be responsible for all the operating units of Starcare in Oman including hospitals at Seeb, Barka and Medical Centres at Bowsher, Mabela and Duqm. “We hope the new CEO would be able to shape the Corporate strategy in line with the expansion plans of the group and the specific requirements of Oman.” said Dr Askar Kukkadi, Managing Director, Starcare Group. The healthcare sector in Oman is undergoing rapid changes highlighted by the presence of private hospitals and the government initiatives to encourage private sector and PPP ventures.

Oman is a youthful country with strong economic indicators and rising population along with prevalence of chronic diseases indicating the need for customized healthcare solutions. Starcare has always believed in adapting the Western standards of quality to suit the healthcare requirements of the nation. “It is my personal goal to increase opportunities for Omani nationals, train and enhance their skills in the process to develop a sustainable healthcare delivery model” commented Nasser Batha in his interaction with the staff members.
